question: For races held at circuits in the UK since 2010, calculate the percentage where Lewis Hamilton did not finish in position 1. Additionally, find the maximum points achieved by British constructors across all their race standings.

prediction.sql:
WITH uk_races AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM circuits c
    INNER JOIN races r ON c.XCL_001 = r.XCL_068
    WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'UK' AND r.XCL_066 >= 2010
),
lewis_results AS (
    SELECT res.XCL_079 AS position
    FROM uk_races ur
    INNER JOIN results res ON ur.race_id = res.XCL_074
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE d.XCL_038 = 'Lewis' AND d.XCL_039 = 'Hamilton'
),
percentage_not_first AS (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN position != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_not_first
    FROM lewis_results
),
max_british_points AS (
    SELECT MAX(cs.XCL_018) AS max_points
    FROM constructorStandings cs
    INNER JOIN constructors con ON cs.XCL_017 = con.XCL_022
    WHERE con.XCL_025 = 'British'
)
SELECT p.pct_not_first, m.max_points
FROM percentage_not_first p
CROSS JOIN max_british_points m

WITH uk_races AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM circuits c
    INNER JOIN races r ON c.XCL_001 = r.XCL_068
    WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'UK' AND r.XCL_066 >= 2010
),
lewis_results AS (
    SELECT res.XCL_079 AS position
    FROM uk_races ur
    INNER JOIN results res ON ur.race_id = res.XCL_074
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE d.XCL_038 = 'Lewis' AND d.XCL_039 = 'Hamilton'
),
percentage_not_first AS (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN position != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_not_first
    FROM lewis_results
),
max_british_points AS (
    SELECT MAX(cs.XCL_018) AS max_points
    FROM constructorStandings cs
    INNER JOIN constructors con ON cs.XCL_017 = con.XCL_022
    WHERE con.XCL_025 = 'British'
)
SELECT p.pct_not_first, m.max_points
FROM percentage_not_first p
CROSS JOIN max_british_points m
